name: walks_dng100
what: the whole fly in closed loop on the flat floor, DNg100 driven at 100 Hz from 300 to 1300 ms; readout the per-leg stepping summary of scripts/probes/command_walk.py. Walking fails today for want of mechanisms (F-BYPASS-7, F-XCONN-2), so this records how far the legs move

harness.note: flyemu.organism.Organism with the body stepped and every sense reaching the brain, the loop of scripts/probes/command_walk.py (observe, sense, network step with the kick, motor step); seeded default_rng(seed); noise per profile

readout.note: each tarsal tip's fore-aft position in the thorax frame, sampled every 1 ms over the window: the dominant frequency inside 3-25 Hz, that band's share of the power and the peak-to-peak amplitude (2 SD); the thorax displacement over the window (mm); the mean rate of vnc_motor neurons and of the DNg100 cells over the window

bar_todo: no bar yet: walking needs its numbers written down first, for example the step frequency band (7-15 Hz, Pugliese 2025), how many legs must step in it and with what band share and amplitude, and a forward thorax displacement. command_walk.py states the band but no threshold. Proposed to the Director 21 Oct, not adopted
reference_script: FLYEMU_PROFILE=m10f0 scripts/probes/command_walk.py --type DNg100 --hz 100 --seed 0 (its stimulus rng is default_rng(1), so seed 0 + offset 1). The script's default --set motor_unit:all|force_per_spike=10 equals m10f0's own value
evidence_status: exploratory seed 0 (command_walk.py is not pre-registered); DNg100 direction was spent on seeds 1-4 in s7 and the bypass DNg100 arms in s20 (register); nothing is scored while there is no bar
